name: better-memory
description: Keeps Claude Code's auto memory to facts that still hold: gates memory writes and sifts new entries when the session goes idle

enabled.title: Guard auto memory
enabled.description: Run the better-memory mod: memory is written only through its tools, entries need anchors, and it maintains MEMORY.md. Off, Claude Code's own memory runs unchanged and only the sift skill remains.

sift.title: Sift when idle
sift.description: Judge new and unchecked entries in a separate Claude process when an interactive session goes idle. Off, entries stay as written until you run the sift skill.
